charts.title: TOI-238 c: orbits around TOI-238
charts.description: The orbits of TOI-238's planets in this map from above, to scale, with TOI-238 c highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: Suárez Mascareño et al. 2024 (2024A&A...685A..56S), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname SUAREZ_MASCARENO_ET_AL_2024): P 8.465651 d
